name: blaym-notebook-types
description: Shared Blaym Jupyter contracts and protocol types

scripts.build: tsc && npm run schema && npm run python:generate
scripts.schema: ts-json-schema-generator --path src/contracts.ts --type '*' --tsconfig tsconfig.json -o schema/blaym-jupyter-contracts.schema.json && mkdir -p python/blaym_notebook_types/schema && cp schema/blaym-jupyter-contracts.schema.json python/blaym_notebook_types/schema/blaym-jupyter-contracts.schema.json
scripts.schema:check: tmp=$(mktemp) && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/contracts.ts --type '*' --tsconfig tsconfig.json -o "$tmp" && diff -u schema/blaym-jupyter-contracts.schema.json "$tmp" && diff -u python/blaym_notebook_types/schema/blaym-jupyter-contracts.schema.json "$tmp"; rc=$?; rm -f "$tmp"; exit $rc
